summary: Model card for Gemini 3.8 Flash, aimed at cost-effective production agents. Reports price and capability benchmarks vs Gemini, Claude and GPT models, automated safety deltas vs Gemini 3.7 Flash (with a multilingual safety regression), a red-teaming summary, and frontier safety inherited from Gemini 3.7 Flash.

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Automated content-safety results reported only as relative deltas vs Gemini 3.7 Flash; manual review said losses were false positives or not egregious.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Overall, Gemini 3.8 Flash performs similarly to Gemini 3.7 Flash across both safety and tone, with low unjustified refusals.

over_refusal.finding: Single relative delta on borderline prompts.
over_refusal.quote: Automated evaluation measuring model's ability to respond to borderline prompts while remaining safe

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Jailbreak resistance named as ongoing work.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: we are continually working to improve jailbreak resistance and have recently strengthened the mitigations across Frontier Safety.

child_safety.finding: Satisfied child-safety launch thresholds; no numbers.
child_safety.quote: For child safety evaluations, Gemini 3.8 Flash satisfied required launch thresholds

multilingual_safety.finding: Regression of +5.4pp (lower is better) in non-English safety vs 3.7 Flash, acknowledged by authors.
multilingual_safety.quote: Safety performance across non-English languages regressed slightly relative to 3.7 Flash.

self_reported_limitations.text: Safety results computed with improved evaluations, not directly comparable with previous model cards.

notes: Frontier safety proxy shifts from Gemini 3.1 Pro (earlier Flash cards) to Gemini 3.7 Flash.
